rows.name: sPHENIX
rows.notes: Successor detector to PHENIX at the same RHIC interaction point (IP8), built around a reused 20-ton BaBar solenoid. DOE CD-0 (2017-01-13), construction complete (2023-04), commissioning/first Au+Au data (2023) and RHIC's final-run closure (2026-02-06) all sourced. lineage.relation 'upgrade_of' -> experiment:phenix recorded here (canonical direction per v0.2 A1); 'successor' is deliberately not written on experiment:phenix.
